section.name: Interface
section.sourcecode: // module: nish/mini/frame export function frame(data: u8[]): u8[] | null

section.name: Framing

blockquote.t: A sender MUST prefix each frame with its length in one octet.

section.sourcecode: // P-PREFIX covers R-PREFIX — a frame is one length octet, then the data forall (data: u8[] /* 0..255 */) => unwrap(frame(data)).length === data.length + 1

blockquote.t: A sender MUST NOT frame more than 255 octets.

section.sourcecode: // P-LIMIT covers R-LIMIT — more than 255 octets is no frame forall (data: u8[] /* 256..300 */) => frame(data) === null
